name: aspect-ratio
useFor: Use for product shots, screens inside windows and media previews so the layout does not jump while they load. Round and frame the media inside with the brand's 12px corners and hairline, or put it in a window.
source: Radix AspectRatio; framing from the brand's windows
title: Aspect Ratio
description: Holds an image or screen at a fixed shape while the width changes.
